slideDifferences.nativeText:
Language Targets
LIKENESS DEGREES
EXAMPLES
HIGH LEVEL
I love drawing cartoons.
She is thrilled about learning languages.
MEDIUM LEVEL
He enjoys working with numbers.
They are fans of running marathons.
LOW LEVEL
We like dancing every weekend.
It is fond of hiding bones in the backyard.
We mainly use simple present to express likes and preferences, but there is an interesting fact we need to consider: likeness degrees.
HINT

We can also use like and preference expressions to talk about people, food, etc. (Not only for hobbies)

The expression thrilled about sometimes is substituted by crazy about.

texts: It is common to use verbs that state preferences when we talk about hobbies. Check the following chart.
I am fond of playing soccer.
NOT TO BE A FAN OF
I am not a fan of watching horror movies.
I am thrilled about reading books.
Notice that after a preference expression, the action can go in ing form.
native.joinedText:
It is common to use verbs that state preferences when we talk about hobbies. Check the following chart.
MOST COMMON VERBS FOR PREFERENCES
NEGATIVE COUNTERPARTS
EXAMPLES
LIKE
DISLIKE / DON’T LIKE
She likes eating ice cream.
ENJOY
DON’T ENJOY
I don’t enjoy cooking.
LOVE
HATE
I love listening to music.
TO BE FOR PREFERENCES
NEGATIVE COUNTERPARTS
EXAMPLES
TO BE FOND OF
NOT TO BE FOND OF
I am fond of playing soccer.
TO BE A FAN OF
NOT TO BE A FAN OF
I am not a fan of watching horror movies.
TO BE THRILLED ABOUT
NOT TO BE THRILLED ABOUT
I am thrilled about reading books.
HINT

Notice that after a preference expression, the action can go in ing form.

texts: C. Read the following text and state if the sentences are true or false.

Joe is a farmer. He loves taking care of animals and plants; also, he has a dog called Chester. Joe enjoys spending time with Chester. They like going fishing on Sundays. Joe is a fan of riding horses but he dislikes cooking only for him. He’s crazy about camping so, he and Chester go camping twice a month.
1.   Joe likes taking care of animals.					(T)     (F)
2.  Joe doesn’t have a dog called Archie.			(T)     (F)
3.  Joe enjoys spending time with Chester.			(T)     (F)
4.  They like going swimming on Sundays.			(T)     (F)
5.  Joe is a fan of riding horses.					(T)     (F)
6.  He likes cooking only for him.					(T)     (F)
8.  Joe and Chester go camping once a month.		(T)     (F)
